**Job description:**

We are looking for an experienced and people\-driven HR Executive to build and manage the people function at Nerditia. You will own the full employee lifecycle — from attracting the right talent to fostering a culture where high performers thrive. This is a strategic yet hands\-on role suited to someone who can operate independently and help scale the team as the agency grows.

**Key responsibilities:**

Talent Acquisition

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for all departments — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer rollout
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and campus outreach
* Collaborate with department heads to define hiring requirements, job descriptions, and evaluation criteria

Employee Lifecycle \& Operations

* Oversee structured onboarding to ensure new joiners integrate smoothly and quickly into teams
* Maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in the HRMS
* Manage payroll inputs, leave tracking, attendance, and statutory compliance in coordination with finance
* Handle offboarding processes including exit interviews, clearances, and final settlements

Performance \& Culture

* Drive the performance appraisal cycle — goal setting, mid\-year reviews, and annual evaluations
* Design and implement employee engagement initiatives, recognition programmes, and team\-building activities
* Act as a trusted point of contact for employee grievances and facilitate timely, fair resolutions
* Identify learning \& development needs and coordinate relevant training programmes across teams
* Partner with leadership to develop HR policies, compensation structures, and workforce planning strategies

**Areas of ownership:**

Talent Acquisition: End\-to\-end hiring across all roles and levels

Employee Relations: Grievances, engagement, and culture building

Performance: Appraisal cycles, L\&D, and goal alignment

Compliance: Labour law, PF, ESIC, and statutory norms

Payroll \& Admin: Payroll inputs, leave, and HRMS management

HR Strategy: Workforce planning and policy development

**About Nerditia:**

Nerditia is a leading performance marketing agency that helps brands grow faster through data\-driven strategy and creative execution. From paid media and SEO to conversion optimisation, we run full\-funnel campaigns that deliver real results. Our team of marketers, analysts, and engineers work together in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment where performance and ownership are everything.

title: Platform Services Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Platform Services team for a 6\-month internship building an AI\-powered solution that directly impacts our Platform Infrastructure. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams — reducing platform toil and accelerating delivery for every engineer at EarnIn — under the guidance of senior platform engineers. This position will be based in Bengaluru, India, as part of our expanding site, and is a contract role from July 2026 to February 2027, targeting university students. This role requires two days a week in the office as part of our growing site location.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Build components of the AI First Responder agent — an automated on\-call triage system that integrates Datadog, Incident.io, and Slack — including agent tooling, evaluation harnesses, and integration workflows.
* Contribute to the IaC migration away from Terraform Cloud — refactoring Terraform modules, cleaning up policies, and building migration scaffolding that clears tech debt and accelerates platform delivery.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real infrastructure context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers across the Bengaluru and Mountain View Platform teams; present your work and learnings to the broader team.
* Shadow incident triage and on\-call workflows to build context on production operations (no on\-call responsibilities).


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university; graduating December 2026 or later.
* Experience with Python, Go, or another backend language — coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), containers (Docker), or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts (Terraform, Kubernetes); classroom or personal\-project experience counts.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow — this is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Comfort working in a Linux/CLI environment and with Git\-based version control.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset — you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly with moderate guidance.
* Prior internship or project experience in platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or site reliability is a plus.
* Familiarity with Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar observability and incident\-management tools is a plus.
* Experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) or building agent\-style workflows in a project context is a plus.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or Helm in any environment (lab, personal cluster, coursework) is a plus.


\#LI\-Hybrid



At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn is an E\-Verify participant.

Oracle PBCS Consultant with 7\+ years of end\-to\-end implementation and support experience across planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. The ideal candidate will design and build PBCS models, lead client workshops, integrate PBCS with ERP/HR systems, and deliver reliable planning solutions with robust data governance and performance tuning.


\-

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design \& Delivery**

* Lead requirement workshops and translate financial planning needs into scalable PBCS/EPM Cloud solutions.
* Design and build Planning models (Workforce, CapEx, OpEx, Revenue, Project Planning) using EPMA/Standard Planning, Data Forms, Smart Lists, and Business Rules.
* Develop Calculation Manager rules (Groovy/Business Rules) and driver\-based models for scenario, version, and year planning.
* Configure Task Lists, Approvals (Workflow), Validations, and Security (roles, provisioning).

**Data \& Integration**

* Design and manage data integrations using Data Management, Connections, and Oracle EPM Integration Agent; build ETL mappings from ERP/GL/HR systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion ERP, EBS, SAP).
* Orchestrate data loads (files, APIs), validate data quality, and monitor integration jobs.
* Implement dimension management (hierarchies), metadata updates, and substitution variables.

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop executive\-ready reports in Oracle Reports, Dashboards, Infolets, and Smart View (Excel/Office).
* Build variance analyses, driver\-based KPIs, and board\-level reporting packs.
* Enable ad\-hoc analysis and self\-service reporting for Finance users.

**Governance, Performance \& Support**

* Establish design standards, documentation, and testing cycles (SIT, UAT).
* Optimize performance (rule tuning, form design, caching), troubleshoot issues, and drive root\-cause analysis.
* Provide hypercare, user training, and ongoing support; manage enhancements via change control.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Finance, FP\&A, and IT teams; run demos and user training.
* Manage delivery scope, risks, and timelines; contribute to effort estimation and project planning.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

  

* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud Planning (at least 2 full\-cycle implementations).
* Strong expertise with:


o Planning Artifacts: Forms, Rules (Groovy/Calc Manager), Approvals, Validations, Smart Lists, Sub Vars.


o Data Management/Integrations: Mappings, Load Rules, Drill\-through, Integration Agent.


o Reporting: Smart View, Dashboards, and Financial Data modeling.

* Solid understanding of FP\&A processes: Annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, rolling forecast, scenario modeling, allocations, intercompany eliminations, currency translations.
* Proficiency in SQL/CSV data handling, and performance tuning within PBCS.
* Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, and conducting UAT/training.
* Excellent communication skills and client\-facing experience.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

  

* Groovy scripting for advanced business rules.
* Integration exposure to Oracle Fusion ERP/EBS/SAP (GL, Projects, HR).

**Education \& Certifications**

**Tools \& Technologies**

**Job Description – Finance Manager**

**Position Title \- Finance Manager** 

**Department \- Finance \& Accounts**

**Experience Required \- 8 – 12 Years**

**Industry Preference \- Construction / Architecture / Interior Design / Real Estate**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance Manager with 8–12 years of experience in the construction, architecture, and interior design industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall financial operations of the organization, leading the finance team, ensuring financial compliance, budgeting, cost control, project finance management, and supporting strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, financial planning expertise, and experience in handling project\-based financial operations within the construction and design sector.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities**

**1\*.** Financial Planning \& Budget Management\*

Prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, and project cost plans.

Monitor organizational financial performance and control project expenditures.

Analyze budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Support management with strategic financial planning and decision\-making.

**2\. Accounting \& Financial Operations**

Oversee daily accounting operations, bookkeeping, and financial transactions.

Ensure accurate maintenance of ledgers, invoices, payments, and financial records.

Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Manage cash flow, banking operations, and fund utilization efficiently.

**3\. Project Finance \& Cost Control**

Monitor project\-wise costing, profitability, and financial performance.

Ensure proper tracking of construction and interior project expenses.

Control operational costs and optimize financial resources.

Coordinate with project teams regarding project budgets and financial approvals.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Management**

Lead, supervise, and manage the finance and accounts team effectively.

Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of financial tasks.

Provide guidance, performance monitoring, and team development support.

Ensure coordination between finance, procurement, HR, and project departments.

**5\. Compliance \& Audit Management**

Ensure compliance with financial regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements.

Handle GST, TDS, payroll compliance, and other financial statutory processes.

Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely audit closure.

Maintain proper financial documentation and compliance records.

**6\. Reporting \& Financial Analysis**

Prepare MIS reports, financial dashboards, and management reports.

Present financial insights and profitability analysis to senior management.

Monitor financial risks and recommend process improvements.

Ensure accurate reporting of project revenue, expenses, and cash flow.

**7\. Vendor \& Payment Management**

Monitor vendor payments, subcontractor billing, and payment schedules.

Verify payment approvals as per project and financial policies.

Maintain healthy financial relationships with vendors and suppliers.

Ensure proper reconciliation of accounts payable and receivable.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial management.

Expertise in project finance, budgeting, and cost control.

Knowledge of GST, taxation, statutory compliance, and audit procedures.

Strong analytical, leadership, and decision\-making skills.

Excellent communication and team management abilities.

Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools.

**Educational Qualification**

CA / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Experience in construction, architecture, interior design, or project\-based industries.

Ability to manage multiple projects and financial operations simultaneously.

Strong leadership experience in handling finance and accounts teams.

High attention to detail, confidentiality, and organizational skills.

title: Director Of Engineering (Site Lead) - Spend Team
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About The Role**


We’re building a world\-class Spend org in Bangalore and looking for a senior engineering leader to serve as our local site lead while directly owning the Accounting Integrations team. This is a rare 0 to 1 plus scale role: you’ll stand up the Bangalore hub, hire and coach managers and ICs, and ship the accounting integration platform that powers Rippling’s finance suite (corporate cards, reimbursements, travel, and accounting automation).

  

You’ll wear two hats:

* Site Lead (matrix): Be the senior presence for Spend in Bangalore—set a high bar, unblock teams, drive performance management, and ensure crisp product\<\>engineering execution across reimbursements, travel integrations, and accounting integrations.
* Direct Owner (line): Lead the Accounting Integrations team to build both the platform and the first wave of integrations (e.g., QuickBooks, Microsoft, and others). You’ll create repeatable pipelines, operational tooling, and the quality bar for how Rippling ships integrations.

  

If you thrive on ownership, love building teams and systems, and want material impact on a product with massive TAM, this is for you.

 **Why this role?**

  

* 0 to 1 with leverage: Your platform unlocks multiple product lines (Spend, Travel, Payroll).
* Massive scope: Travel \+ Spend are multibillion\-dollar markets; integrations are a core growth lever.
* Career runway: Build the Bangalore Spend org from the ground up and shape the architecture and culture that others scale

 **What You'll Do**

* Build the Bangalore hub: Hire, level, and grow a 25\+ person org; stand up rituals, on\-call, quality bars, and velocity tracking.
* Own Accounting Integrations end\-to\-end: Define the technical roadmap and delivery plan for an integrations platform that serves both Spend and Payroll; ship the next set of GA integrations.
* Raise the execution bar: Diagnose churn early, clarify requirements, and drive PR/Design quality; get teams shipping the right thing, fast.
* Manage managers \+ ICs: Mentor junior EMs; directly manage ICs initially and transition scope as leaders ramp.
* Operational excellence: Build support and observability for integrations (routing, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, data quality, SLAs).
* Partner deeply: Work with Product, Design, GTM, and Finance Ops to prioritize impact, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly.
* Scale through platforms: Establish reusable contracts, SDKs, tooling, and CI/CD standards so new integrations land in weeks—not quarters.
* Be the site leader: Set crisp goals, run calibration, address underperformance fast, and model hands\-on, detail\-oriented leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years in engineering leadership, including 2\+ years managing managers or large multi\-team groups
* Proven 0 to 1 and scale experience: shipped platforms or integrations with high reliability and throughput
* You like being technical. Strong technical depth in distributed systems, APIs/webhooks, and data modeling. Comfortable reviewing designs and PRs
* Operational mindset: built systems with monitoring, alerting, rate limits, retries, reconciliation, and clear SLOs/SLAs
* People leader: hires great talent, levels accurately, runs calibrations, manages performance with candor and speed
* Product sense: You can turn ambiguous requirements into shipped outcomes while balancing speed with quality
* Nice to have: prior work with accounting/ERP systems, travel content providers, or financial data flows

title: HR manager
description:
Job description

HR Executive Supermarket Candidates (Only Apply)

Reporting To: MD

We are looking for a Professional Human Resources Executive for Leading Supermarket shop.

Qualification: MBA or MSW (or Any Degree)\_

Experience Required: 3 to 5 Years in HR profile especially in HR supermarket.

responsibilities include recruiting and training new hires, managing employee data and taking steps to retain our people. To be successful in this role, you should have a good knowledge of labor legislation and experience hiring employees for various roles and seniority levels.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:1\. Recruitment \& Onboarding

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment process: job postings, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and issuing offer letters.
* Coordinate onboarding, induction, and documentation for new hires.
* Maintain and update employee database and personnel files.

2\. Attendance \& Payroll Support

* Monitor attendance, leave records, and coordinate with accounts/payroll for timely salary processing.
* Manage biometric systems and resolve related issues.

3\. Employee Engagement \& Communication

* Organize employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Serve as a communication bridge between management and staff.
* Handle grievance redressal and support conflict resolution.

4\. Compliance \& Record\-Keeping

* Ensure compliance with labor laws (PF, ESI, etc.) and dealership policies.
* Prepare and submit required HR\-related reports (statutory and internal).
* Maintain confidentiality of all employee records.

5\. Training \& Development

* Coordinate with managers for identifying training needs.
* Schedule and maintain records of training programs.

6\. Exit Formalities

* Manage resignation, clearance, and full \& final settlement processes.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition data.

Key Skills Required:

* Strong understanding of HR practices and labor laws
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in MS Office \& HRMS software
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources / Business Administration / related field (MBA preferred)
* 3–5 years of HR experience (Supermarket Industry Experience)

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**About Us**
------------



Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.


From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity\-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.


**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**


Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------



1\. National Sales Planning \& Forecasting


* Lead AOP (Annual Operating Plan) and rolling forecasts at national level


* Design target allocation frameworks across states, clusters, and territories


* Ensure alignment of targets with market potential, seasonality, and business priorities


* Monitor performance vs plan and recommend strategic interventions

  



2\. Sales Incentive Plan (SIP) – Design \& Governance


* Design and implement Sales Incentive Plans (SIP) for field teams aligned to business objectives


* Define clear KPIs, payout structures, slabs, and eligibility criteria


* Ensure SIP drives:



1\. Business growth



2\. Market share improvement



3\. Focus on priority products / geographies


* Track SIP effectiveness, payout vs performance correlation


* Continuously refine plans based on behavioral outcomes and business impact

  



Role Manager / Senior Manager – Sales Planning \& Operations



Department/Brand Tractor Sales



Location Greater Noida



Reports to Director Sales



3\. Scheme Strategy, Rollout \& Actualisation


* Conceptualize and deploy national and channel schemes


* Ensure structured rollout communication and execution timelines


* Monitor actualisation vs scheme intent and budget utilization


* Provide insights on scheme ROI and market competitiveness

  



4\. DMS Governance \& Digital Discipline


* Drive national governance of Dealer Management System (DMS)



Ensure:



1\. Data accuracy



2\. Timely data entry



3\. Billing discipline



4\. Stock visibility


* Define KPIs and track dealer/system compliance levels


* Partner with IT for system enhancements and adoption

  



5\. Sales MIS \& Business Analytics


* Develop and standardize central MIS dashboards and reporting frameworks


* Provide actionable insights on:



1\. Retail vs billing gap



2\. Market share trends



3\. Scheme and SIP performance



4\. Dealer funding \& inventory health


* Enable leadership with data\-backed decision\-making tools

  



6\. Sales Organization Planning \& Productivity


* Design and optimize sales structure and manpower deployment


* Define span of control, coverage norms, and productivity benchmarks


* Identify gaps in coverage, capability, and performance


* Work with HR on hiring plans, KRAs, and performance management frameworks
**Experience Required**
-----------------------


* Graduate / MBA (preferred)


* 10–18\+ years in sales planning / incentive design / sales operations


* Experience in automobile / tractor / rural markets preferred


* Prior exposure to Head Office / Central roles
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Graduate / MBA (preferred)


* 10–18\+ years in sales planning / incentive design / sales operations


* Experience in automobile / tractor / rural markets preferred


* Prior exposure to Head Office / Central roles
**Job Purpose**
---------------



To drive centralized sales planning, incentive strategy, performance governance, and system\-led execution across regions by designing robust frameworks for target setting, sales incentives (SIP), scheme effectiveness, MIS, and organization productivity, enabling consistent and profitable growth.

**What We Offer**
-----------------



We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.


At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:


* *Flexible work arrangements*
* *Savings \& Retirement benefits*
* *Tuition reimbursement*
* *Parental leave*
* *Adoption assistance*
* *Fertility \& Family building support*
* *Employee Assistance Programs*
* *Charitable contribution matching and Volunteer Time Off*

title: Team Leader
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."



* Location
Bengaluru
* Employment type
Full Time Permanent
* Department
People \& HR
* Deadline
2026\-06\-09

  
Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language About you
  

  

Are you passionate about exceeding goals and fostering team success? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, multi\-national environment? Are you eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes bettering everyday life for many people? If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team.
  

  

We're seeking a candidate with a strong foundation in HR with minimum 12\+ years of experience, particularly in payroll and personnel administration (PA/PY), coupled with an advanced understanding of pay\-the\-worker processes. Alongside this expertise, familiarity with HR\-related tax and legal matters is essential.
  

  

A comprehensive understanding of the IKEA HR system landscape is a definite advantage, as is proficiency in modern office practices, procedures, and equipment. While a basic understanding of the IKEA system is required, we're also looking for candidates who demonstrate potential management or leadership skills, as this role may involve guiding and leading teams toward shared objectives.
  

  

You
  

  

* have passion for working with people and you successfully lead them by example,
* communication in English is your strong point, and you are eager to use it while cooperating with various partners all over the world
* bring a true passion for people and enjoy working in a vibrant and changing environment,
* thrive in a dynamic, fast\-changing environment and are passionate about transitions and driving change.
* have a service oriented and customer focused background, a strong drive and the ability to take decisions and delegate,
* have understanding and passion for IKEA values and want to share it with your team.
* have strong knowledge of HR Processes (including Payroll) (with min. 5 years of experience) preferably IN (India) HR processes and with min 3\-5yrs of People Manager experience.
* build strong relationships and collaborate easily with different stakeholders
* are well\-organized, proactive, and able to prioritize effectively

  

Last, but not least – you are a true ambassador for IKEA Culture and Values.
Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us
Key responsibilities (text) As the leader of a GBO People Services team, you're responsible to lead one of the GBO People Services teams for India, which is responsible for P\&C processes (Personnel Administration, Payroll, Recruitment, Onboarding, Offboarding, Benefits, Learning and Development) as per defined and agreed scope, execute delivery of services on high professional standard and strive to meet or exceed agreed service levels.
  

  

As a People Services Team Leader you will:
  

* Lead the country Personnel Administration/Payroll team to deliver high\-quality services efficiently, including monthly and yearly activities.
* To ensure efficient and high\-quality PA/PY service delivery in line with global procedures and local legal requirements.
* Adhere to defined KPIs/SLAs.
* Act as an expert, leading solution implementation.
* Develop team competence through coaching and training.
* Resolve issues, manage escalations, and follow up on outstanding topics in promptly and a timely manner.
* Drive continuous process improvement.
* Closely cooperate with Project Leader to secure migration plan for any transferring/transitioning services.
* Active participation \& coordination in relevant project deliverables
* Foster strong relationships with partners.
* Allocate resources effectively and create a motivated, high\-performing team environment
* Manage, coach, and develop team members, strengthening their knowledge, skills, and engagement.
* Recruit and onboard competent new co\-workers that will fit the team with the required PA/PY profiles
* Motivate the team to deliver outstanding service.
* Promote a culture where IKEA values are a strong and visible part of everyday work.
* Actively contributes to project deliverables and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.

This role is situated within Bangalore and will report directly to the GBO Service Delivery Manager or GBO People Services Manager for India. Also, this role requires working from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM to support India customers, with the flexibility to extend working hours when needed.
Team vision ( title) About this work area
Team vision (text) Global Business Operation (GBO) is a function within the IKEA Group of companies. We work with transactional services in the field of Finance and HR. We deliver our services through our regional hubs, located in Poznan, Shanghai, Bangalore and Baltimore.
### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home\-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.  

  

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co\-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.  

  

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.
### **What we all have in common**


* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing \& delivering while learning \& developing
* Having fun!

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description**
  

 Globus is a leading global producer of release liners, dedicated to serving the pressure\-sensitive adhesives industry with high\-quality products. With over 30 years of expertise in silicone coating, Globus exports to more than 55 countries. Equipped with advanced technology, solvent\-less silicone coating and slitting lines, the company can produce and customize liners across various sizes and formats. Annually, Globus has the capacity to coat up to 350 million square meters of paper and film, showcasing its commitment to efficiency and excellence.
   

  

**Role Description**
  

 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Human Resources Manager at Globus, based in Khopoli. The HR Manager will oversee all HR functions, including recruitment, employee relations, training and development, and compliance with employment laws. Responsibilities include managing payroll, implementing HR policies, fostering a positive workplace culture, handling performance evaluations, and addressing employee concerns. The HR Manager will also work closely with department heads to align HR strategies with organizational goals.
   

  

**Qualifications**
  

* Proficiency in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, and Workforce Planning
* Strong understanding of Employee Relations, Conflict Resolution, and HR Policies
* Expertise in Training, Learning \& Development, and Performance Management
* Knowledge of Compliance, Employment Laws, and Regulatory Standards
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
* Proficiency in HR Management Software and Microsoft Office Suite
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Prior experience in manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus

title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
Are you a builder who learns by doing? Do you spend your free time tinkering with code, breaking things, and fixing them just to see how they work? If so, we want to talk to you.

We are looking for a motivated **Mobile App Developer** with a passion for **Flutter and Kotlin** to join our team in a flexible, internship\-style collaboration. We don’t care about a perfect 5\-page corporate resume or decades of formal job experience. **We care about your ability to build real, functioning software.**

Whether you are a student, a self\-taught developer, a recent graduate, or an engineer transitioning from another stack—if you have a GitHub repository full of experimental projects, freelance work, or college apps you are proud of, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)**

As a core contributor to our mobile ecosystem, you won't just be fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. You will be treating this like a real product ownership role. You will:

* **Build \& Iterate:** Develop, test, and deploy new mobile app features using Flutter and Kotlin.
* **Craft UI/UX:** Translate design wireframes into smooth, responsive, and pixel\-perfect user interfaces.
* **Connect Systems:** Integrate backend services, RESTful APIs, and cloud databases (like Firebase).
* **Debug \& Optimize:** Hunt down bugs, profile app performance, and continuously iterate based on user feedback.
* **Influence Product:** Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute directly to product development decisions. Your voice matters here.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Core:** Flutter with Web support (Dart) \& Backend (Kotlin)
* **Plus Skills (Nice to have):** Firebase ecosystem, REST APIs, Git/Version Control, and general Flutter knowledge.

**Who You Are (Requirements)**

We are looking for a specific mindset rather than a specific degree. You are a great fit if you possess:

* **Hands\-on Building Ability:** You have already built and deployed (or at least run locally) real projects.
* **High Curiosity \& Ownership:** You don't just wait for instructions. You look at a problem, research solutions, and take ownership of the outcome.
* **Independent Problem\-Solving:** You are comfortable digging through documentation, Stack Overflow, or AI tools to unblock yourself when you get stuck.
* **Consistency:** Because this is a remote and flexible role, you must be a disciplined self\-starter who can communicate effectively and hit agreed\-upon milestones.

*This Role is Ideal For:*

* **Students \& Freshers** looking for high\-impact, real\-world development exposure to supercharge their portfolios.
* **Self\-Taught Developers** who need a platform to prove their skills on a production\-level app.
* **Engineers Transitioning** from web or backend development into the mobile space.

What We Offer

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere, at any time that suits your schedule, provided deadlines are met.
* **Mentorship \& Growth:** Work on real\-world problems that will teach you more in a few months than a year in a lecture hall.
* **Portfolio Building:** Ship code that you can actually point to and say, *"I built that feature."*

**How to Apply**

To skip the corporate red tape, please include the following in your application:

* A link to your **GitHub profile, portfolio, or specific app repositories** (Applications without code samples will not be considered).
* A brief summary or links to **projects you’ve built** and what your role was in creating them.
* A **short introduction** about yourself, your coding journey, and why you want to work with Flutter/Kotlin.
* Your **current availability** (how many hours per week you can consistently dedicate to this collaboration).

Pay: From ₹4,000\.00 per month

**Experience:**

* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**Job Title:** Customer Support \& Operations Executive  
**Company:** KNV Ventures (parent company of a growing Indian D2C brand)  
**Location:** Remote \- India  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month **Experience:** 0–2 years (freshers welcome)

**About Us**

KNV Ventures is the parent company behind a fast\-growing Indian D2C health brand. We sell health supplements directly to customers across India and we're scaling quickly. As we grow, we need someone to own customer support and day\-to\-day operations so our customers always have a smooth experience.

→ To apply, you must fill out our short application form (link at the bottom). Applications without the form will not be reviewed.

**Role Overview**

We're hiring a Customer Support \& Operations Executive who will be the main point of contact for our customers and the person who keeps our orders moving smoothly.

On the support side, you'll help customers with all their questions, whether it's about the product itself or about their order. Most of this happens over WhatsApp and email, with the occasional inbound call (call volume is low, so this is a small part of the role). Customers will ask things like how the product works, when their parcel will arrive, or why a delivery is delayed, and you'll guide them clearly and patiently across whichever channel they reach out on.

On the operations side, you'll manage the shipping side of things end to end. This means handling NDRs (non\-delivery reports), managing RTO (return to origin) orders, raising and tracking tickets on shipping aggregator platforms, and coordinating with courier partners. Since you're already the one talking to customers, you'll also keep them updated on their order status and resolve any delivery issues directly with them.

In short, you'll own both the conversation with the customer and the journey of their order, making sure both run smoothly from start to finish.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Fluent in English and Hindi, comfortable communicating clearly over WhatsApp, email, and the occasional call
* Strong written communication, you can explain things simply and politely in text
* Organized and detail\-oriented, able to juggle support conversations and shipping tasks at the same time
* Calm and patient when handling customer concerns or delivery issues
* Has a laptop/computer, stable internet, and a quiet workspace
* Available to work 10 AM – 7 PM IST, Monday to Saturday
* Available to start within 7–10 days

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

* Experience with Shopify
* Experience with shipping tools (Shiprocket, Delhivery One, iThink Logistics, Nimbuspost)
* Experience with WhatsApp tools (Zoko, KwikEngage, Interakt, Wati)
* Prior customer support or e\-commerce operations experience

**What We Offer**

* ₹15,000/month to start, with a clear path to ₹20,000–₹25,000 after a 3\-month performance review based on your performance
* Work directly with the founder and learn how a D2C brand runs end to end
* Fully remote, work from anywhere in India
* Real growth opportunity as the company scales into a role with more responsibility and ownership

**How to Apply (Important)**  
This is the only way to apply. Fill out our short application form here:

https://jointura\-cs\-ops\-typeform.vercel.app/

We review every form submission personally. Applications that skip the form will not be considered.

title: Customer Support Manager - HRIS
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Customer is about much more than just the numbers. It’s about attesting to accomplishments and challenges and helping to assure strong foundations for future aspirations. Deloitte exemplifies the what, how, and why of change so you’re always ready to act ahead. Learn more about Customer



  

**Job Responsibilities:**



We are looking for a Consultant/Senior Consultant/Manager for Customer Strategy and Applied design focused on Strategy \& Operations. The role involves responsibility for leading a discrete work stream or module on a large\-scale project or overall delivery lead in case of short term/ small scale engagement. The key focus sectors would be TMT organizations.



For instance, on a Strategy project for a telecommunication company, focused on recommending strategies for revenue uplift – involving market assessment, conducting primary/ secondary research, analyzing competitor landscape, strategies, pricing models and market share, deep dive analysis on selected KPIs, data analytics, building a financial model to estimate potential revenue and costs under different scenarios, identify key regulatory considerations and partnership opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategy and presenting findings/ recommendations to the client’s leadership teams. The extent of analysis, hands\-on implementation expected varies from case to case, and depends on the size of the team and scope of the project.



The responsibilities can include:


* Build and maintain a solid understanding of the client's business objectives and processes to become a trusted advisor for all issues related to business strategy, operations, performance, revenue generation and cost optimization.
* Develop/define \& implement strategic programs to enhance business penetration \& increase revenues for the client, or rationalize costs.
* Identify and make recommendations for actions to improve business performance and drive incremental revenue.
* Working with internal teams, and clients to develop and implement long term and short term engagement objectives and work plan
* Thinking through a solution lens and working with client and Deloitte’s teams to deliver engagements


* Leading small client and internal teams to understand, design, enhance, confirm and deliver objectives of the engagement


* Working in alignment with the internal and client team to ensure a streamlined delivery model with seamless integration of the final deliverable across modules
* Communicating, analysis, recommendations and status updates in both written and oral communication with internal and client leadership
* Report writing and preparation of final deliverable
* Assisting seniors in responding to client requests, RFPs and problem statements with proposals
* Building the relationship between Deloitte and the client’s project team


**Job Qualifications:**



Successful candidates will have a degree from a top\-tier MBA, Engineering, BBA or B.Com. Program, have 1\-2 years (C), 3\+years (SC), 8\+years (M) of relevant business experience, and the ability to meet each of the following criteria:


* An entry level (C) or expert level of knowledge (SC or M) in telecom business, operating model, product \& pricing strategies, marketing, sales\-distribution, and data analysis techniques
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting specially in thinking through large andcomplex engagements
* Background or experience (through coursework or employment) in TMT organization (optional for freshers)
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Leadership qualities, project management skills, and the ability to mentor
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* Candidates from all academic backgrounds are encouraged to apply


* Willingness for long term international or domestic travel



Personal Qualities Valued:


* Passionate in participating and working on complex engagements and opportunities
* Intellectually powerful and agile: curious, rigorous, and creative
* Emotionally intelligent: high ability to build strong relationships that inspire openness and trust; to collaborate in teamwork settings with colleagues and clients; and to balance inquiry and advocacy in all personal interactions
* Comfortable with working on difficult issues where there can be no definitive “right” answer; patient in the face of uncertainty, complexity and ambiguity
* Capable of working on multiple, overlapping tasks in a fast\-paced environment

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About Lokal :**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (LokalMatrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, SahiJobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
   

  

 We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
   

  

**Role Overview :**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical Business Analyst / Data Analyst to support data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. This role involves working closely with business, product, and operations teams to analyze data, generate insights, improve processes, and translate business needs into actionable solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, building dashboards, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive measurable business impact.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities :**
* Key Responsibilities:
* Gather, evaluate, and prioritize business and technical requirements from stakeholders
* Collaborate closely with business, product, and operations teams to ensure alignment and clarity
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business insights
* Build dashboards and reports to track key business metrics and performance
* Translate business questions into structured analytical problems
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend data\-driven improvements
* Support forecasting, performance tracking, and decision\-making initiatives
* Assist in designing and implementing business solutions backed by data insights
* Document business requirements, process flows, and key definitions clearly
* Present insights, recommendations, and findings effectively to stakeholders


**Requirements**
* Strong SQL and Excel proficiency
* Experience with dashboards/visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio)
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to translate business questions into data analysis
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills


**Why Join Us?**
 We're scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you'll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
**About Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd**

Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd (BGT) is a globally recognized technology and engineering services company with over **30 years of experience** in structural steel detailing, BIM solutions, advanced robotic fabrication, and engineering consultancy. Headquartered in **Chicago, Illinois**, BGT operates a state\-of\-the\-art **30,000 sq. ft. ODC in India**, serving clients across Commercial, Institutional, Healthcare, Industrial, and Mining sectors in the US and Canada.

Driven by precision, quality, and innovation, BGT has built strong, long\-standing partnerships with leading global organizations. At BGT, **people are our greatest asset** — and we continuously invest in nurturing the next generation of talent to sustain our legacy of excellence.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **HR Recruiter (Fresher)** to join our HR team at Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd. This is a great opportunity for **2025 \& 2026 batch graduates** to gain hands\-on exposure to the complete recruitment lifecycle — from sourcing and screening candidates to scheduling interviews, stakeholder follow\-ups, and facilitating smooth hiring. You will also participate in conducting initial interview rounds, building practical experience in candidate evaluation and hiring decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Sourcing \& Candidate Management**

● Source and attract candidates through various platforms including job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Shine), social media, employee referrals, and campus recruitment drives.

● Create and post compelling and accurate job advertisements in alignment with role requirements and company culture.

● Build and maintain a robust talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs across various departments.

● Screen resumes and application forms to shortlist candidates who match the required qualifications and experience profile.

**Interview Scheduling \& Coordination**

● Schedule and coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and the respective hiring managers or department heads.

● Manage interview logistics — sending calendar invites, sharing interview formats, and ensuring all stakeholders are well\-prepared.

● Coordinate panel availability and ensure timely scheduling without conflicts or delays.

● Maintain organized records of interview schedules, outcomes, and feedback in the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or HR systems.

**Candidate Follow\-Up \& Communication**

● Proactively follow up with candidates at every stage of the recruitment process to keep them informed and engaged.

● Send timely communication including interview confirmations, feedback notifications, offer letters, and onboarding instructions.

● Build positive candidate relationships and maintain a professional, empathetic, and responsive communication approach.

● Track candidate drop\-offs, understand reasons, and provide feedback to improve the candidate experience.

**Interview Participation \& Evaluation**

● Actively participate in conducting initial screening rounds and HR interviews for shortlisted candidates.

● Evaluate candidates on communication skills, attitude, cultural fit, and overall suitability for the role.

● Share structured feedback and hiring recommendations with senior HR team members after each interview.

● Develop and refine interview questionnaires and competency\-based assessment tools over time.

**End\-to\-End Recruitment Support**

● Manage the complete recruitment workflow — from job requisition receipt to offer rollout and pre\-onboarding formalities.

● Coordinate with department heads to understand exact hiring requirements, timelines, and job specifications.

● Maintain and update daily/weekly recruitment trackers and MIS reports for management review.

● Assist in organizing walk\-in drives, job fairs, and campus placement events as required.

● Support the onboarding process by coordinating documentation, induction scheduling, and day\-one readiness for new joiners.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Educational Qualification**

● MBA/MSW (Human Resources) from a recognized university or institution.

● Candidates who have completed their degree in the year 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply.

● Candidates awaiting results of their final semester/year are also encouraged to apply (subject to qualification confirmation).

**Skills \& Competencies**

● Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of regional languages is an added advantage.

● Good interpersonal skills with the ability to engage professionally with candidates, hiring managers, and team members.

● Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office tools — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

● Familiarity with job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, or Shine is preferred.

● Ability to multitask, prioritize workloads, and work effectively under deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

● High attention to detail with strong organizational and follow\-up skills.

● Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within the HR function.

**What You Will Gain at BGT**

This role is designed to give fresh HR graduates a comprehensive, real\-world understanding of the recruitment function in a professionally managed, globally connected organization. As part of the BGT HR team, you will:

● Gain end\-to\-end exposure to the entire recruitment lifecycle in an international work environment.

● Develop hands\-on skills in talent sourcing, candidate engagement, interview facilitation, and offer management.

● Learn to work with structured HR processes, tools, and reporting systems.

● Receive mentorship from experienced HR professionals and leadership teams.

● Build confidence in conducting interviews and assessing talent across varied roles and seniority levels.

● Be part of a reputed, 30\+ year old engineering and technology organization with a strong global presence.

Detailed Job Description

Detailed Job Description

Field Details

Role Management Trainee \- Warehouse \&

Client Operations

Department Warehousing \& Supply Chain Operations

Location Warehouse\-based role \- Delhi

Experience Freshers / 0\-1 year

Role Overview

GMS Worldwide Express Pvt. Ltd. is looking for young, energetic, and highly communicative supply\-chain graduates

who are willing to build their career in warehousing, logistics, and client operations.

This role is designed for freshers or early\-career candidates from a supply chain, logistics, operations, or business

management background. The selected candidate will be trained in warehouse operations, inventory control, inbound

and outbound processes, WMS usage, client coordination, MIS reporting, and day\-to\-day operational monitoring.

The candidate will not be expected to perform manual pick\-and\-pack work. However, the candidate must be willing to

work from the warehouse floor, monitor activities closely, coordinate with internal teams, ensure process discipline,

and communicate professionally with clients and management.

This role is ideal for candidates who want to grow into future warehouse managers, assistant managers, key account

operations executives, or supply chain operations leaders.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Warehouse Operations Monitoring

Monitor day\-to\-day warehouse activities including inbound, stocking, inventory movement, order processing, picking,

packing, dispatch, returns, and coordination with transport teams.

Ensure that warehouse activities are carried out as per defined SOPs, client requirements, and internal process

standards.

Coordinate with warehouse in\-charges, supervisors, DEOs, pickers, packers, and transport teams to ensure smooth

operational flow.

Track whether daily tasks are completed on time and highlight delays or process gaps to the reporting manager.

2\. Inventory \& WMS Coordination

Monitor inventory accuracy in the warehouse and system.

Support the team in ensuring correct scanning, binning, stock updates, serial number tracking, condition\-based

inventory handling, and timely WMS updates.

Coordinate with the WMS/data entry team to ensure that all inbound, outbound, and inventory movements are

updated correctly.

Highlight mismatches, short or excess stock, damages, wrong entries, ageing inventory, pending updates, or any stock

discrepancies to the reporting manager.

3\. Client Coordination \& Communication

Act as a coordination point between the warehouse team, internal management, and client\-facing teams.

Communicate professionally over email and calls with internal stakeholders and, wherever required, client teams.

Prepare clear updates on warehouse status, pending activities, dispatches, inventory issues, escalations, and

operational challenges.

Since GMS handles international clients, especially UK\-based and France\-based clients, excellent English

communication is a mandatory requirement.

4\. MIS, Reporting \& Follow\-Up

Prepare and share daily/weekly operational reports as per internal and client requirements.

Track inbound, outbound, pending orders, inventory discrepancies, dispatch status, pickup status, delivery

coordination, and ageing cases.

Follow up with internal teams to close pending tasks and maintain proper documentation and reporting discipline.

Support the reporting manager with accurate data, clear summaries, and timely escalation points.

5\. Process Improvement \& Escalation

Identify operational gaps and report them to management.

Support in improving warehouse workflows, documentation, reporting formats, and accountability.

description:
**Recruitment Executive – Overseas Recruitment**

Job Summary

The Recruitment Executive is responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating candidates for overseas employment opportunities. The role involves managing the end\-to\-end recruitment process, maintaining client relationships, negotiating with candidates, and ensuring timely fulfillment of manpower requirements for international clients.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Source candidates through job portals, social media, databases, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on client requirements.
* Conduct telephonic, virtual, and face\-to\-face interviews.
* Assess candidates’ qualifications, experience, skills, and suitability for overseas assignments.
* Maintain an updated candidate database and talent pipeline.

Client Requirement Management

* Understand client manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Coordinate with overseas clients regarding vacancies, recruitment status, and candidate profiles.
* Ensure timely submission of suitable candidate CVs to clients.
* Meet recruitment targets and project deadlines.

Candidate Coordination

* Communicate job opportunities, salary packages, benefits, and employment terms clearly to candidates.
* Coordinate interviews, trade tests, and client selection processes.
* Guide candidates through documentation, visa, medical, and deployment procedures.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment cycle.

Negotiation \& Relationship Management

* Negotiate salary expectations and employment terms between candidates and clients.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.
* Handle candidate concerns and resolve recruitment\-related issues professionally.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Verify candidate documents, qualifications, and employment history.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and overseas recruitment regulations.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and reports.
* Prepare recruitment reports and status updates for management.

Required Qualifications

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or any related field.
* Additional certification in Recruitment, HR, or Talent Acquisition is an advantage.

Experience

* **2–3 years of experience in Overseas Recruitment / International Manpower Recruitment.**
* Experience recruiting for GCC countries, construction, oil \& gas, healthcare, hospitality, retail, IT, or engineering sectors is preferred.
* Experience handling bulk hiring and international client requirements is an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Ability to conduct competency\-based interviews and candidate assessments.
* Strong sourcing and networking capabilities.
* Knowledge of recruitment portals, social media recruitment, and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Good interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet recruitment targets.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of positions successfully closed.
* Time\-to\-fill vacancies.
* Client satisfaction levels.
* Candidate retention and deployment success rate.
* Recruitment target achievement.
* Quality and accuracy of candidate submissions.
* Database growth and candidate engagement.

Working Conditions

* Full\-time office\-based role.
* Occasional travel for recruitment drives, job fairs, and client meetings.
* Flexible working hours during urgent recruitment projects.

Salary Range

* As per company policy, qualifications, and experience.

Career Progression

Recruitment Executive → Senior Recruitment Executive → Recruitment Team Leader → Recruitment Manager → Operations Manager

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Age: 22–35 years.
* Professional, target\-oriented, and self\-motivated.
* Strong customer service mindset.
* Ability to build long\-term relationships with clients and candidates.
* Experience in handling multicultural candidates and international recruitment processes.

description:

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

* Understand client requirements and present suitable solutions/services

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Apollo.io

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field

**What would you do?** The HRMS OM Specialist is responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and hierarchy of the organization’s structure within the Human Resources Management System (HRMS). You will bridge the gap between HR strategy and technical execution, ensuring that every "box" on the org chart is correctly defined, funded, and aligned with business goals. Employee Services refer to the support and resources provided by an organization to its employees. This includes HR assistance, payroll processing, benefits administration, training programs, and wellness initiatives. The goal is to enhance employee satisfaction, productivity, and overall well\-being. The design of employee data processes to manage employment data, records and transactions using standard technologies and processes.  

**What are we looking for?** Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Information Systems, or Business Administration. Technical Proficiency in HRMS modules (OM/PA) and advanced Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables). Analytical Ability to interpret complex organizational charts and translate them into system logic. Attention to Detail High precision in data entry; a single wrong "Parent ID" can break company\-wide workflows. Communication Ability to explain technical system constraints to non\-technical HR Business Partners.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •Structure Maintenance: Create, modify, and delimit organizational units, jobs, positions, and task assignments within the HRMS (e.g., SAP, Workday, Oracle). Hierarchy Management: Ensure reporting lines (Who reports to whom?) are accurate to drive automated workflows for approvals, payroll, and security permissions. Data Integrity: Audit organizational data regularly to identify "orphaned" positions, vacant roles, or incorrect cost center assignments. Restructuring Support: Partner with leadership during mergers, acquisitions, or internal re\-orgs to mass\-upload changes and simulate new structures. Position Control: Manage "Position Management" logic—ensuring new hires are only mapped to approved, budgeted headcount. Reporting \& Analytics: Generate visualizations of the span of control, vacancy rates, and departmental growth trends for executive review.
