title: Head of Human Resources
description:
HR Manager – HR Operations, Talent Acquisition \& Cross\-Border Compliance (India \& Saudi Arabia)
 








**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR professional to lead HR Operations and Talent Acquisition across India and Saudi Arabia. The role requires a strong blend of recruitment expertise, HR operations excellence, labor law compliance, employee relations, and policy management. The ideal candidate will bring 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with proven capability in managing cross\-border HR operations, scaling teams, and supporting business growth in dynamic environments.
 







 The candidate should also have experience working closely with attorneys/legal counsels on HR policy drafting, employment contracts, disciplinary matters, compliance frameworks, and labor law\-related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 









**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand workforce planning and hiring requirements
* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies through job portals, referrals, social media, and recruitment networks
* Lead hiring initiatives across India and Saudi Arabia, including high\-volume and niche hiring
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Track and analyze recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, and quality of hire



**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management** 



* Oversee complete employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and exits
* Manage employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave management, and payroll coordination
* Maintain HRIS systems and ensure employee data accuracy and confidentiality
* Support audits and maintain audit\-ready HR records and documentation
* Streamline HR processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability



  





  





**Compliance \& Labor Law Management** 



* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and Saudi labor regulations including Saudization, Iqama, GOSI, visa, and work permit requirements
* Coordinate with PROs and external agencies for employee documentation, visas, and expatriate workforce management
* Work closely with attorneys and legal counsels on HR policy drafting, employment agreements, disciplinary procedures, compliance matters, investigations, and labor law documentation
* Maintain and update HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and compliance frameworks across regions
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, statutory regulations, and corporate governance standards



**Compensation, Benefits \& Performance Management** 



* Manage salary structures, compensation revisions, benchmarking, and benefits administration
* Oversee expatriate compensation, allowances, and per diem structures
* Drive performance appraisal cycles, goal\-setting frameworks, and employee feedback processes
* Support leadership in talent development, succession planning, and retention initiatives



**Employee Relations \& Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee queries and support
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary actions, investigations, and conflict resolution
* Foster a positive and inclusive work culture across locations
* Lead employee engagement and retention initiatives



**HR Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Generate HR dashboards, MIS reports, and analytics for leadership review
* Provide data\-driven insights to support HR and business decision\-making
* Monitor key HR metrics and recommend process improvements







**Key Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations and Talent Acquisition
* Strong exposure to HR operations in both India and Saudi Arabia
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and Saudi labor regulations
* Experience managing cross\-border and expatriate workforce
* Proven experience working with attorneys/legal teams on HR policy drafting, compliance, contracts, and employee relations matters
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms and recruitment tools
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and organizational capabilities
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced and dynamic business environments







**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in scaling teams and managing high\-volume recruitment
* Strong analytical mindset with data\-driven decision\-making capabilities
* Exposure to multinational or multi\-location organizations
* Ability to align HR strategy with overall business objectives
* Strong process orientation with a focus on operational excellence

***Location:*** *Chennai, India*  
***Experience:*** *3\-5 years*  
***Employment Type:*** *Full\-time*

***About the Role***

*We're building next\-generation digital twin platforms for smart buildings and industrial facilities. We need BIM specialists who can create accurate, data\-rich building models from laser scans, coordinate multi\-discipline designs, and integrate 3D models with real\-time operational data to power facility management and predictive analytics.*

* Develop and maintain LOD 300\-500 BIM models using Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) for commercial, industrial, and manufacturing facilities
* Execute Scan\-to\-BIM workflows: process point cloud data using ReCap, convert laser scans to accurate parametric models with validated geometric tolerances
* Perform clash detection and federated model coordination using Navisworks; manage clash sets, issue tracking, and resolution logs with design and trade partners
* Create and structure parametric Revit families, parameters, and templates per BIM Execution Plan (BEP) and project standards
* Implement BIM standards (LOD definitions, shared parameters, naming conventions, worksharing); perform QA/QC and model health audits
* Integrate BIM models with 4D scheduling (construction sequencing) and 5D cost estimation for project delivery optimization
* Collaborate with GIS analysts and IoT engineers to create digital twins with real\-time monitoring and predictive maintenance capabilities
* Generate construction documentation, quantity takeoffs, material schedules, and asset information for facility management handover
* Conduct constructability reviews and coordination workflows using Navisworks/Revizto with multi\-stakeholder teams

* **Autodesk Revit** (Architecture, Structure, MEP) – Expert proficiency with 3\+ years hands\-on modeling, family creation, and template management
* **Autodesk Navisworks** – Clash detection, coordination review, 4D simulation, and conflict resolution
* **AutoCAD** (2D/3D) – Editing legacy drawings, creating construction documents, integrating older project data into BIM workflows
* **Point Cloud Processing** – ReCap or equivalent tools for as\-built modeling from laser scan data

* Multi\-discipline coordination experience across Architectural, Structural, and MEP systems
* BIM standards knowledge: ISO 19650, LOD specifications (200\-500\), IFC data exchange, COBie delivery

* Basic **Python or C\# scripting** for BIM automation and data extraction

***Digital Twin Context***

***What Makes This Role Different:***

* Beyond traditional BIM: integrating 3D models with IoT sensor data, SCADA systems, and facility operations
* Creating "living" building models that update with real\-time performance data for predictive maintenance
* Bridging construction phase BIM with operational digital twins for lifecycle asset management
* Collaborating with software engineers, data scientists, and facility managers—not just architects and engineers

***You'll Learn:***

* GIS integration and spatial coordinate system management
* Real\-time data visualization overlays on BIM models
* API\-based data exchange between BIM platforms and IoT/FM systems
* Industry 4\.0 concepts applied to building and facility management

***Qualifications***

***Experience:***

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
 Application Security Engineer
   

  

**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
 IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
   

  

 The bar is high – bring a curious and forward\-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
   

  

**Your team**
 We are seeking a passionate “Application Security Engineer” who has hands\-on experience in securing applications across SDLC, Penetration Testing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying vulnerabilities, conducting security assessments, collaborating with developers and helping to embed security best practices into product development.
   

  

**Your role in the Team's Success**
 Your role contributes to the success of the AppSec team by proactively identifying and mitigating application security risks, collaborating with developers and product teams to embed security early in the SDLC, Penetration Testing, SAST/DAST, Secret management, WAF, Purple Team Exercise . The position also supports process improvements, leverages automation to deliver security at pace, and helps strengthen overall security awareness across the organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Perform security assessments/Penetration Testing of web, mobile, and cloud\-based applications.
* Conduct secure code reviews, threat modelling, and architecture reviews.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Identify, validate, and track remediation of vulnerabilities discovered through SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration testing.
* Develop and enforce secure coding standards and guidelines.
* Execute Purple Team/Red Team exercise and work closely with SOC team on this.
* Provide training and guidance to developers on application security best practices.
* Research and stay up\-to\-date with emerging security threats, tools, and techniques.
* Support incident response and root cause analysis for application\-related security issues.


**What You'll Need For This Role**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security or related field.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in Application Security / Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) / Cyber security / Offensive Security.
* OSCP certified with hands on experience with Penetration Testing
* Strong understanding of common vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques (OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with one or more security tools:
+ SAST (Checkmarx, Fortify, SonarQube, etc.)
+ DAST (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, AppScan, etc.)
+ SCA (Black Duck, Snyk, etc.)
+ WAF(Akamai, Barracuda,etc)

* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related security controls.
* Exposure to bug bounty programs or responsible disclosure.
* Strong knowledge on Attack simulations/Red team/purple team exercise.
* Working knowledge of DevOps/DevSecOps tools and processes (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD).
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.


**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**
* Experience with container and Kubernetes security.
* Knowledge of API security testing (Postman, SoapUI, or Burp plugins).
* Experience in secure code review.


**How We Work**
 We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office \-\- which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other. When it comes to how we deliver, there are 5 things we want everyone to do to drive high performance, better learning and career satisfaction:
   

  

* Lead and Inspire: Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* Think Big: Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* Champion the client: Understand and prioritise client's needs
* Deliver at pace: Push for fast, sustainable growth;
* Raise the bar: Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback


 We believe that diversity is vital to success, it fuels creativity, drives innovation and sets us up for global success. We're committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey. Learn more about our D\&I approach here.
   

  

**The Perks**
 Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.
   

  

 Learn more about the Perks here!
   

  

**Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!**

description:
PLC Programmer – Job Description

**Job Title:** PLC Programmer  
**Department:** Automation / Electrical Engineering  
**Reports To:** Automation Manager / Project Manager

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled **PLC Programmer** to design, develop, test, and maintain programmable logic controller (PLC) systems used in industrial automation. The candidate will work closely with electrical engineers, technicians, and project teams to implement reliable automation solutions for manufacturing and industrial processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, program, and troubleshoot **PLC control systems** for industrial machines and processes.
* Design and modify **PLC logic, HMI screens, and SCADA systems**.
* Perform **system testing, debugging, and commissioning** of automation systems.
* Integrate PLCs with **sensors, motors, drives and other industrial equipment**.
* Read and interpret **electrical drawings, P\&IDs, and control diagrams**.
* Maintain and upgrade existing PLC programs to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Provide **technical support and troubleshooting** for production issues.
* Document programs, system configurations, and maintenance procedures.
* Work with cross\-functional teams during **installation and startup** of automation systems.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **PLC programming** (Ladder Logic, Function Block, Structured Text).
* Experience with PLC platforms such as:
* **Siemens (S7, TIA Portal)**
* **Allen Bradley (RSLogix / Studio 5000\)**
* Mitsubishi / Omron (optional depending on company).
* Experience with **HMI and SCADA systems**.
* Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols** (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, Profinet).
* Ability to read **electrical schematics and control panel drawings**.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

Qualifications

 Vedantu is a leading learning platform delivering value to students across grades and competitive exams. We are on a mission to make high\-quality education accessible and engaging for every learner.
 



**Role Overview** 




 This role sits at the intersection of AI products and revenue systems. You will own the automation and intelligence layer that powers lead qualification, routing, and conversion across Vedantu's sales funnel. Beyond the core systems, you will also run experiments to improve conversion at every funnel stage — from first bot interaction to enrolment. This is a hands\-on role — you will work directly with the tech, the CRM stack, and the sales team to build systems that are fast, intelligent, and measurable.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* AI Voice \& chat \- Own conversation flows, intent design, architecture, escalation logic, and quality. Work with stakeholders to ship, iterate, and drive conversion.
* Lead lifecycle \& routing — Own multi\-signal lead qualification, scoring, and distribution logic. Reduce leakage, improve routing accuracy, and cut time\-to\-first\-contact.
* Automation \& engagement — Build the automation layer — bot follow\-ups, smart scheduling, and multi\-channel activations that reduce manual effort.
* Growth experimentation — Run rapid experiments across the funnel with engineering, marketing, and business. Own the metrics, iterate fast, and ship what works.
* CRM \& integrations — Own LeadSquared configuration, workflows, and integrations across telephony, marketing platforms, payment systems, and internal tools.
* Funnel intelligence — Define real\-time dashboards tracking latency, routing effectiveness, capacity utilisation, and conversion health. Own the metrics leadership acts on.

* Hands\-on experience building voice bots or conversational AI products — from conversation design and intent flows to integration and deployment. Experience with LLMs or intelligent automation is a plus.

* Demonstrable funnel understanding — ability to identify leakages, diagnose drop\-offs, and connect product decisions to funnel outcomes.
* Strong product discovery skills — user research, experimentation design, prioritisation frameworks, and iterative validation.
* Comfortable reading API docs, working with engineers on integration logic, and writing crisp PRDs.
* SQL fluency or strong data tool comfort — you build dashboards and interpret experiments, not just consume reports.
* 1–4 years of product management experience with clear ownership of strategy, execution, and measurable outcomes.

As Country Business Partner based in Noida, you’ll be the go\-to HR leader for your local market, while working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with talented peers across APAC, from Singapore to Beijing, Brisbane and beyond.
   

  

 Reporting to the APAC Senior Director of People Delivery and Employee Relations, you’ll translate global People strategy into real\-world impact, shaping culture, enabling leaders, and driving an exceptional employee experience. You won’t be a remote outpost; you’ll be a valued member of a genuinely collaborative regional team that supports and invests in each other’s success.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with business leaders as a trusted HR advisor turning people insights into practical solutions that accelerate local business goals.
* Lead employee relations matters end\-to\-end, guiding managers through complex workplace situations with confidence and care, ensuring compliance with local employment law.
* Drive People programs champion the rollout of global and local HR initiatives, including engagement surveys and change management.
* Champion culture and belonging embed company values, act on engagement data, and foster an inclusive workplace where people do their best work.
* Shape policy and practice partner with Centres of Excellence to design people policies that are locally relevant, legally sound and consistently applied.
* Influence without authority navigate a global matrix, partner across time zones and bring regional leadership along on the journey.


**Essential**
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* 6\+ years of progressive HR experience
* Proven employee relations expertise
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law
* Track record partnering with business leaders
* Experience in a matrixed, global environment
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business or related field
* Fluent English (written and spoken)


**DESIRABLE**
* 2\-3 years in a dedicated HRBP role
* Master’s degree or MBA
* Professional HR certification (SHRM, CIPD or similar)
* Experience in publishing, technology or professional services
* Exposure to APAC multi\-country HR


**Why Join Us**
* Work in a truly regional team, your peers are HR professionals based across APAC, offering genuine collaboration and shared learning across cultures.
* Senior Manager\-level scope with real influence, you’ll operate as a true partner for both leaders and colleagues.
* Broad remit across partnering, ER, culture, and program delivery, ideal for an ambitious HR professional who wants variety and depth.
* A people\-first organisation committed to inclusion, employee wellbeing and building a culture where everyone can thrive.


**We power infinite possibilities.**
 For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.
   

  

 We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.
   

  

 Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.
   

  

 Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.

Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well\-being of all employees. We offer meeting\-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

title: TAA - Governance
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated professional who has eye for details.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Recruitment team to ensure they adhere to the process. We are committed to follow the process \& policy.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Ability to work with complex information spread across multiple stakeholders
* Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive data with discretion
* Improve operational efficiencies by identifying opportunities for automation and developing templates
* Be able to manage compliance and audit related activities


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong verbal communication, listening and interpretation skills.
* Have eye for details
* Ability to work in large teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in HR or Diploma in Human Resources
* 1\-3 years of experience into recruitment \& reporting
* Proficient in advanced MS Excel, word, PowerPoint


**What We Look For**
* Quick learner, with a positive attitude
* A self\-starter and problem solver with an ability to work in fast pace entrepreneurial environment.
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Open to working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global Talent Acquisition team is a high\-performing group of recruitment subject matter experts who are committed to building strong partnerships with candidates as well as our internal stakeholders across the globe. We strive to provide exceptional, reliable recommendations and service, while fostering a flawless candidate experience. We value creativity, free\-thinking/ideation as well as collaboration. It is our belief that bringing diverse perspectives and experiences together provides a strong foundation for both personal and professional growth and development.
   

  

 This role is a remote position based in India on a 6 Month fixed\-term contract, working the night shift to support U.S/ UK time zones as part of our global recruiting operations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a temporary / contract Talent Acquisition (TA) Coordinator to support significant growth over the next 6 Month. You will join a fast growing global Talent Acquisition team that is responsible for full\-cycle recruitment of the best talent in the market as we build and scale AlphaSense. This contract TA Coordinator will join an established team of coordinators and recruiters and will provide administrative and operational support to ensure the candidate experience runs smoothly at all times.
   

  

 While this is a temporary position for a duration of 6 Month, there may be opportunities for an extended contract or conversion to a permanent role based on business needs and performance. This would be a great role for someone with an interest in building or may have started their career in Talent or HR/People Operations role!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Provide administrative support to the Talent Acquisition team, such as posting job openings, sending offer letters, pulling reports, organizing Google Drive, editing presentations, etc.
* Correspond with candidates throughout the entire interview process, including scheduling phone/video interviews, sending out case studies/assignments, managing candidates in our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse) and providing updates to the team.
* Become a Greenhouse power\-user and assist in the management and administration of the system so that our team can be efficient, consistent, and have accurate data at all times.
* Partner closely with our team of coordinators and recruiters to learn and improve upon our existing programs and processes.
* As needed, provide in\-office support for any onsite candidate interviews in our office, including booking conference rooms, greeting candidates, and ensuring interviews are running on schedule.
* As needed, collaborate with the people operations team to ensure a seamless transition from candidate to employee, and ensure that everyone has what they need for new hire orientation.


**Who You Are**
* Energetic and Approachable: You bring a positive attitude, are friendly, and eager to assist, making you an excellent main point of contact for candidates and internal teams.
* Highly Organized and Process\-Oriented: You excel at creating, documenting, and implementing systems and processes that keep you and your team consistent and efficient.
* Detail\-Oriented and Meticulous: You have a keen eye for detail, ensuring candidate\-facing communications like emails and job descriptions are polished and error\-free.
* Exceptional Communicator: With strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills, you can effectively engage with a high volume of candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Driven and Self\-Motivated: You thrive in high\-growth environments with ambitious goals, eager to contribute to building a business at scale.
* Sense of Urgency and Accountability: Your excellent time\-management skills and follow\-through ensure tasks are completed efficiently and accurately.
* Adaptable and Flexible: You embrace fast\-paced environments and adapt seamlessly to change.
* Creative and Entrepreneurial: You see growth opportunities in challenges, taking ownership of projects and driving innovation.
* Eager to Learn and Develop: With access to training and tools, you're open to growth and committed to advancing your career at AlphaSense.
* Professional and Trustworthy: You handle sensitive information with integrity, discretion, and confidentiality.
* Tech\-Savvy: Proficient in Google Suite (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs), you leverage technology to its full potential. Strong proficiency with ATS systems, especially Greenhouse, is highly preferred.


 Location: Remote India
   

  

 Duration: Fixed Term: 6 Month
   

  

 Shift Timings: 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST
   

  

 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
   

  

 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud
   

  

 We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note
   

  

* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
* All official communications will come from an @alpha\-sense.com email address.
* If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.


 If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Recruitment & Operations Specialist, Global People Operations
description:
**Recruitment \& Operations Specialist, Global People Operations** 




*Location: Dakar, Senegal; Delhi, India; Lusaka, Zambia; Manila, Philippines; Nairobi, Kenya; or Rabat, Morocco* 




  





**About the Recruitment \& Operations Specialist, Global People Operations role** 




 Our Global Operations team is the fuel maintaining a uniquely dynamic and high\-achieving multicultural, multi\-continental team at the cutting edge of how evidence is used to improve global development programs. This team’s mandate is to attract top talent, create the best place to thrive at work, and build the systems to allow IDinsight teams to achieve social impact.
 



 Our team is currently looking for a Recruitment \& Operations Specialist, Global People Operations. This role would be a great fit for someone who thrives working in a fast\-paced, high\-energy, get\-it\-done environment and is excited to grow professionally alongside a high\-performing team. An ideal candidate is someone who has a strong recruiting foundation and a passion for connecting exceptional people to meaningful work.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Reporting to the Manager of Global Operations based in Nairobi, Kenya, and working with our Global and Regional Operations teams, the Specialist will be responsible for the following workstreams:
 



**Owning Org\-Wide Recruitment:** 



* Lead and oversee global recruiting drives for teams hiring across multiple geographies, in conjunction with the Global Operations team.
* Lead organizational recruitment initiatives to ensure IDinsight teams are achieving their hiring goals; execute on global recruiting strategies to ensure IDinsight is finding and winning the best talent in the sector
* Partner with regional operations and functional teams to understand hiring needs and provide timely, high\-quality support
* Manage end\-to\-end recruiting processes, including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, and offer management
* Track recruiting metrics and pipeline data to inform hiring decisions and improve process efficiency



**Improving Recruitment Processes:** 



* Analyze recruiting metrics and pipeline data to identify process improvements and enhance efficiency
* Develop and maintain global recruiting strategies, including building and nurturing relationships with US, UK, and other international universities to connect with students and plan global recruiting events
* Continuously optimize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) for better data integrity and positive candidate experience



**People Experience \& People Operations:** 




 As a secondary focus to recruitment, this role will also contribute to other workstreams led by the Global People Ops team and act as a reliable execution partner across people operations workstreams, stepping in where needed to move priorities forward and ensure strong follow\-through. These could include:
 


* **Onboarding:** 
 Coordinate onboarding logistics and materials, maintain onboarding content and systems, and support onboarding sessions as needed. Ensure new hires have what they need to get started smoothly.
* **Employee Transitions:**
* Support the coordination and tracking of employee transitions, including promotions, relocations, and leave processes, ensuring processes are completed accurately and on time.
* **Performance Reviews:** 
 Support the execution of performance review cycles and related processes. This includes managing timelines and follow\-ups, supporting data tracking and analysis, handling system administration (Lattice), and assisting with promotion processes to ensure everything runs smoothly.
* **Offboarding:** 
 Support offboarding processes, including managing checklists, updating systems, and maintaining alumni records to ensure clean and consistent transitions.
* **Employee Experience \& Culture** 
 : Support the delivery of key people experience and operations priorities across IDinsight, working closely with Global and Regional Operations teams. This includes contributing to initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, team culture, and overall employee experience.



  





**Qualifications** 




 We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, “get stuff done” teammate with 3\-5 years of relevant experience. Desired qualifications include:
 


* 3\-5\+ years of
 **professional experience in talent acquisition** 
 ,
 **people operations,** 
 human resources, operations, or international development
* Proven track record in
 **full\-cycle recruiting** 
 , ideally within
 **non\-profit, development,** 
 or
 **mission\-driven** 
 organizations
* Demonstrated experience managing and optimizing an
 **Applicant Tracking System**
* Experience
 **partnering directly with hiring managers to define role requirements** 
 , align on candidate profiles, and move searches forward efficiently
* Proven ability to
 **source and engage passive candidates** 
 through LinkedIn, job boards, university networks, and other talent channels
* **Detail\- and execution\- oriented** 
 , able to take a task from high\-level strategic idea to rapid execution with a large amount of autonomy and conscientiousness;
* Demonstrated
 **track record as a self\-starter and leader** 
 , including comfort with ambiguity and dynamic environments and work streams
* **Strong communicator** 
 in multiple fora (written communications, public speaking, teamwork, and upward management)
* Strong
 **desire for professional growth** 
 and development, with a track record of openness to give and receive feedback
* **People\-focused and people\-facing** 
 , with high levels of empathy and desire to listen to and share in teammates’ victories, concerns, and needs
* Strong ability to maintain
 **integrity and confidentiality** 
 in complex situations;
* Ability to
 **handle sensitive information** 
 , data, and issues with mature and discreet professionalism
* Ability to work with
 **international, cross\-cultural, and diverse teams**



  





**Professional Development** 




 Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long\-term impact strategy, and have been noted highlights of teammates’ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership, support from talented peers, and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real\-time feedback is embedded in our culture, and formal structure enables maximum professional growth.
 



  





**Nuts and Bolts** 




**Location** 




 This is a full\-time employee position; location is flexible, with preference for an IDinsight office location. IDinsight has office locations in Dakar, Senegal; Rabat, Morocco; Nairobi, Kenya; Lusaka, Zambia; Delhi, India; and Manila, Philippines. Please note IDinsight is not able to sponsor work authorization for this role.
 



**Compensation** 




 Compensation and benefits are commensurate with relevant experience and background, and competitive within the social sector. Please note, as a non\-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading private sector organizations.
 



**Start date** 




 The start date of this position is June 2026\. We expect a two\-year minimum commitment, with regular professional development conversations and potential for a long\-term career at IDinsight.
 



**Work authorization** 




 IDinsight is not able to sponsor work authorization for this role. Successful candidates will not require IDinsight to sponsor their work authorization in the office in which they'll be based.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 Please click the "Apply for this job online" button at the top right. Applications are rolling and are considered as they are submitted. The application asks various questions in order for us to get to know you, and
 **requires a CV.** 
 Please answer the application screening questions truthfully and completely. As an organization that values honesty and integrity, we expect transparent and accurate responses throughout our selection process.
 



 Please ensure that your CV includes relevant professional and personal experience as well as details on academic qualifications. CVs can range from one to two pages. Headshot photographs, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and other personal information not relevant to the application do not need to be included in your CV.
 



 More information, including details on IDinsight’s hiring process and frequently asked questions, can be found online at IDinsight Careers. Any questions should be directed to careers@IDinsight.org.
 



  





**IDinsight’s commitment to reducing power asymmetries** 




 IDinsight is committed to
 



**reducing power asymmetries in the social sector** 
 . Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs that are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work.
 



 We seek a workforce that is inclusive of a variety of perspectives that will help us refine and improve our methods and relationships, and strengthen the services we provide our clients and their communities or constituencies. The following commitments represent our vision for the IDinsight team:
 


1. IDinsight will have greater representation from the
 **populations with whom we work** 
 and the
 **clients we serve** 
 .
2. IDinsight will have greater representation from the
 **countries in which we work** 
 .
3. Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek
 **greater representation from historically excluded communities** 
 .
4. IDinsight will foster an
 **inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team** 
 to do its best work.



 IDinsight is committed to non\-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and organizational culture, regardless of people’s age, disability, gender, gender identity, national origin, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a / an
 **Software Developer** 
 to be part of making this/that happen
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 Data is a critical part of Arctic Wolf Network’s mission to solve cyber risk, where we process and analyze trillions of events every week to look for malicious and risky behavior. These set of Data Pipelines form the critical backend of all our products and services. The Data Engineering team works on ingesting massive amounts of security data and logs, refining and enriching the data as it flows through the pipeline and service them at a high performance for all the products and stakeholders.
   

  

 As a Data Engineer on this team you will be responsible to create data pipelines for our suite of cybersecurity products and services. They will partner with Product Managers, Security Researchers, ML teams and various other teams that are engaged in the data world in AWN. You will work with SQL, Spark, Databricks, Athena/, Iceberg/Trino to write and optimize ETL/ELT jobs to ingest raw data from a variety of sources, refine that data, and optimize/tune those datasets into production. You should be comfortable with relational\- and non\-relational databases like SQL and PostgreSQL, big data systems such as Spark, and cloud\-deployments of software and ETL jobs in AWS.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Software Developer at ARCTIC WOLF, you will:
   

  

* Design and implement distributed, fault\-tolerant Big data ETL/ELT pipelines for stream and batch processing in Databricks.
* Implement data streaming and event\-driven architectures using Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS, etc.
* Deploy infrastructure and pipelines using Terraform, Terragrunt, Jenkins and other CI/CD tools.
* Continuously improve data availability, quality, and performance for Data workloads.


**Experience And Requirements**
 We’re looking for someone with experience in:
   

  

* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL with up to 2 years of experience in a Software Developer role.
* Mindset to learn complex systems and self\-driven attitude to work.
* Proficiency in SQL and Database design and familiarity with Databricks.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS services \- S3, RDS, EC2\.
* Familiarity with Terraform, Terragrunt.
* A collaborative mindset and a passion for solving complex data challenges.

If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
   

  

 We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
   

  

 We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All

 wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

**Job Title:**

 3 – 5 Years
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You will help build and maintain the data infrastructure underpinning the AI and analytics products within EY’s Global Insights function. Our goal is to equip EY professionals with differentiated market, sector, and company insights to strengthen EY’s brand, enhance client relationships, and drive commercial impact.

Working under the guidance of senior team members and in collaboration with analysts and business stakeholders, you will build and operate Azure\-based data pipelines and databases, contribute to data warehouse and data lake solutions, help define technical requirements, and build and maintain BI and analytics dashboards. **Key Responsibilities**

* Perform daily monitoring of data pipelines and data quality, including validation checks, issue triage, and resolution.

* Follow established data security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Continue learning modern data engineering tools, platforms, and best practices.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Demonstrated success in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including schema design, joins, aggregations, and query optimization.
* Experience working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL) and familiarity with non‑relational data stores.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure data services (e.g., Azure SQL, Data Factory, Data Lake), or strong exposure to cloud‑based data platforms.
* Understanding of data warehousing and data lake concepts, including batch and near‑real‑time data processing.
* Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformation workflows
* Working knowledge of Python or PySpark for data processing and transformation workflows is a plus
* Experience supporting data quality, pipeline monitoring, and issue resolution
* Familiarity with data security, privacy, and governance standards
* Proficiency with modern development workflows, including GitHub‑based collaboration and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience building and supporting BI and analytics dashboards (e.g., Power BI), including working with DAX and semantic models.
* Effective communication with technical and non‑technical audiences, including translating business needs into technical tasks
* Demonstrated willingness to learn modern data engineering tools and best practices.


**What We Look For**
* 3 \- 5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or a related field.
* Interest in building scalable, reliable data infrastructure and products
* A focus on delivering outcomes through continuous improvement
* Curiosity, collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn from teammates
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities


**What We Offer**
* Hands\-on experience supporting enterprise data platforms and analytics use cases.
* Structured learning, mentorship, and skill development opportunities.
* Exposure to modern data technologies and best practices.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment focused on growth and impact.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

description:

 The ideal candidate is a problem solver who enjoys digging into technical issues, proactively identifying improvements, and working independently without micromanagement. They should have a strong desire to learn, grow, and take initiative while collaborating with teams across different regions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This position involves supporting global network operations, ensuring optimal performance, implementing security policies, and leading high\-impact network projects to modernize and enhance our infrastructure.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of relevant hands\-on Network Engineering experience in medium\-to\-large enterprise environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze and resolve complex network issues across all OSI layers.
* Experience designing and supporting Cisco ISE and 802\.1X authentication (wired and wireless).

* Familiarity with network security principles, segmentation, firewall rule management, and NAC policies.
* Hands\-on expertise with Wireless (Meraki, Cisco WLC), DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S, SSH, SMTP, and SNMP monitoring tools.
* Experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., OpManager, SolarWinds, PRTG, Cisco ThousandEyes, Splunk, or similar).
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks/projects without needing micromanagement.
* Must have a growth mindset, strong curiosity, and a passion for continuous learning and improvement.
* Excellent documentation skills and ability to communicate technical details clearly.


**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):**
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems.
* Industry certifications: CCNP, CCIE, JNCIS, JNCIA (or equivalent).
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco Nexus ACI, VXLAN, and Data Center networking.
* Experience with Meraki Wireless, SD\-WAN, and Infoblox DNS management.
* Cloud networking experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Familiarity with network automation tools (Python, Ansible).


**Responsibilities**
 The role will focus heavily on

 , and the engineer will be handling a high volume of tasks, including:
   

  

* Incident tickets – triaging and resolving operational network issues
* Change requests – assisting with planning, documentation, and execution
* Vendor ticket follow\-ups – ensuring timely resolution and communication
* Monitoring and response – proactive network monitoring and alert handling
* Process improvements – assisting with network hygiene, documentation, and automation opportunities
* Support on projects – contributing to both large and small projects with specific technical tasks

 Duracell is the world’s leading manufacturer and marketer of high\-performance alkaline batteries, complemented by a portfolio of high quality, market leading specialty, rechargeable and professional batteries. Duracell’s products power numerous critical professional devices across the globe such as heart rate monitors, defibrillators, telemetry devices, smoke detectors, fire alarms, automated valves and security systems. As the leader in the professional power category, Duracell has a rich history of innovation, continuously introducing batteries that are smaller, thinner, with more energy and longer lasting than competitive brands. Since March 2016, Duracell has found its permanent home within Berkshire Hathaway (ranked \#4 World's Most Admired Companies by Fortune Magazine and \#3 in the Fortune 500\), and will continue to focus on sustainable growth, industry\-leading innovation while creating long\-term value for our customers and consumers. At Duracell, integrity, end\-to\-end accountability across all levels, fast decision\-making and a “can do” attitude is highly valued.

description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 At Xerox,
 **we make work, work!** 
 For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients and within our culture. Learn more at www.xerox.com and explore our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Network Engineer
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 Our technology is outstanding, but it’s the talented, diverse, and driven people behind our company who make it all happen. Our employees have the determination to go further, the adaptability to adjust to an ever\-changing global market, the heart to stay passionate and personally invested, and the mind to know when to step back and put it all in perspective.
   

  

 Lexmark (A Subsidiary of Xerox Corporation) is in search of a seasoned network operations engineer with a passion for operating, executing, and enhancing standard processes for maintaining an enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation of IT operations, security, and network policies. The role involves working with architecture and business teams to ensure the availability of the enterprise network. The engineer will also be responsible for monitoring tool efficiency, setting guidelines, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, they will liaise with other IT operation teams to resolve any network\-related issues. The ideal candidate must possess robust communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
   

  

 Remote Administration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, and cloud networks.
   

  

 Configuration and management of multiple network security systems to include next gen firewalls, unified threat management services, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
   

  

 Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.
   

  

 Execution of standard network delivery processes such as VLAN creation, route advertisements, firewall policy configurations, DNS record changes, IPAM network creation, network performance reports, network infrastructure hardening, software/hardware licensing, and virtual network peering.
   

  

 Coordination of high\-impact infrastructure changes and outages during on and off\-hours.
   

  

 Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
   

  

 Act as the escalation contact for the network helpdesk and incident managers.
   

  

 Communicate regularly with management and architecture teams on operational metrics.
   

  

 Light travel will be required to meet with international teams.
   

  

 Hands on support for the deployment of new infrastructure and maintenance of existing infrastructure at the company headquarters location.
   

  

 Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.
   

  

**Must\-have Qualifications, Skills, Experience**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 3\-5 years of networking and security experience.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, VLAN, Public Cloud, Wireless, and VoIP networking technologies.
   

  

 Advance knowledge of routing protocols to include Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network security concepts, including web filters, NIDPS, DLP, SSL\-DPI, firewalls, etc.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network services, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SNMP, IPSec, NetFlow.
   

  

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
   

  

 Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
   

  

 Experience with client facing Network Operations Center (NOC) support.
   

  

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of Operational Processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

 Preferred Certifications:
   

  

 Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-900, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-204\)
   

  

 CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+)
   

  

 Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

**Years Of Experience In This Field**
 3 to 7 years of experience as a Network Engineer in a global company.

description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start\-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values\-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989\.
   

  

 Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full\-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking for a
 **Network Engineer – WAN** 
 to join our global network operations team. This role focuses on supporting wide\-area network infrastructure, with an emphasis on routing protocols, large\-scale data center connectivity, and secure site\-to\-site communications. You will work with Cisco Nexus and ASR platforms, troubleshoot complex WAN issues, and collaborate with global teams to ensure highly available, secure, and scalable network services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support, configure, and maintain WAN infrastructure across medium\-to\-large enterprise networks.
* Troubleshoot and resolve WAN incidents, perform root cause analysis, and document solutions.
* Implement and optimize MPLS, OSPF, and BGP routing in complex enterprise topologies.
* Collaborate with network architects and cross\-functional teams to design and execute WAN changes.
* Support VPN solutions (site\-to\-site, IPSec, SSL\-VPN) and ensure secure interoffice connectivity.
* Work with firewall policies and monitoring systems to maintain network security posture.
* Maintain detailed network documentation, topology diagrams, and change records.
* Participate in change management processes and on\-call rotations.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience working with medium\-to\-large networks focusing on IP routing, switching, and security.
* Strong knowledge of MPLS, OSPF, and BGP and how they interact with the network.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco IOS (IOS\-XR and Nexus OS).
* Familiarity with Cisco Nexus 9k/7k/5k/2k, ASR 1000/9000 routers, and Catalyst platforms.
* Knowledge of Palo Alto firewalls and SSL\-VPN solutions.
* Exposure to large data center designs, inter\-office routing plans, site\-to\-site VPNs, FW/ IPSec implementations, and monitoring.
* Experience connecting lab equipment, conducting proof\-of\-concepts, and documenting solutions with diagrams.
* Data\-driven, analytical problem solver with demonstrated operational success.


**Nice\-to\-Have:**
* Experience with VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and SBC solutions.
* Exposure to large data center interconnects, interoffice routing plans, and FW/IPSec implementations.
* Familiarity with incident response, vulnerability management, SIEM, IDS/IPS monitoring, and TCP/IP traffic analysis.
* Knowledge of Linux network functions and SaaS/Cloud networking (GCP/AWS/Azure).
* CCNP or equivalent certification.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.


**Additional Information**
**We offer:**
* Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year\-over\-year revenue growth.
* Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
* Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
* Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
* Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
* Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team\-building company social events.
* Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.
* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

 Are you a tech\-savvy problem\-solver with a passion for ensuring optimal network performance? If so, look no further – Kyndryl is seeking a Network Support Specialist who will be the go\-to expert for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting computer networks.
   

  

 As our Network Support Specialist, you'll be working in a complex, multi\-vendor environment, and will use your analytical skills to identify and resolve network issues, make configuration changes, and implement security policies. This role requires someone who can think on their feet, test and apply corrective actions (including emergency changes), and participate in change reviews as needed. And with the ever\-changing nature of technology, you'll be constantly learning and growing in your role.
   

  

 You will work alongside a talented team of experts to plan and execute routine network changes, troubleshoot and solve network issues and outages, and maintain excellent communication with our end customers, project managers, and service engineers. You’ll be responsible for maintaining network components, monitoring network performance, and maintaining network security. You will also be providing user support for network\-related issues, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support possible.
   

  

 If you're ready to take on a fast\-paced and rewarding role in the world of network support, apply to join the Kyndryl team today!
   

  

 Your Future at Kyndryl
   

  

 Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
* Proven knowledge and experience in trouble\-shooting, switching, and routing
* 2\+ years of working experience in Networking
* Minimum CCNP certification or equivalent knowledge
* Experience with Network security, WAN
* Working knowledge of ITIL


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Experience with BGP, Software Defined Networking (SDN) based on Cisco ACI, Checkpoint/Cisco Firepower firewalls, F5 load Balancers, NSX
* Experience with Ansible automation


**Being You**
 The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
   

  

**What You Can Expect**
 Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
   

  

 From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

title: Antenna System Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 Take the next step in your career as a Senior Antenna System Engineer in Ericsson Antenna Systems, where your strong competence will directly shape the performance and innovation of the cellular communication industry.
   

  

 In this role, you will influence our product technology compass, guide R\&D efforts, and set industry benchmarks from within our organization. This role offers a platform to apply your comprehensive and deep technical knowledge, collaborate across functions, and drive technological leadership. As an expert, you will mentor peers, inspire creative problem\-solving, and strengthen Ericsson’s competitive edge. Together, we will continue setting the standard for antenna systems worldwide.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Drive best in class system performance: with profound and extensive expertise in Active Antenna Systems, radiators, signal distribution networks, filters, materials, mechanical aspects, and EM simulation tools, align technology, product, and operational strategies for innovative antenna solutions; create customer system value; assess maturity and cost\-effectiveness of technology for product; stay on the verge of industry trends and adopt relevant developments; identify disruptive innovations and explore emerging technologies to sustain leadership.
* Drive Portfolio Innovation: with a comprehensive system view of challenges and solutions, provide in‑depth technical proposals and systemizations for complex problems; assess portfolio break downs to sub functional technology levels in correlation to product KPI’s and industry benchmarking; identify portfolio harmonization and scalability maintaining product value proposition; participate in defining the direction of Ericsson’s R\&D activities
* Influence with Technical Expertise: impact business by influencing the whole organization and teams, as well as the customer, to materialize next generation antenna driven solutions in the market. Acts as technical lead and advisor for investigations and upper management in Ericsson.
* Drive Knowledge Sharing and Collaboration: promote learning within Ericsson and across the organization; act as teacher/mentor to inspire others and enable their technical growth; develop personal competence; foster cross‑functional collaboration; participate in or lead communities of practice and external academic collaborations as relevant.


**The Skills You Bring**
* Antenna HW for cellular systems
* Comprehensive and deep understanding of the network level impact of the antenna features, which enables optimal architecture ideation and concept selection, specifically within the segment of Active Antenna Systems
* Extensive knowledge on market \& industry requirements, Ericsson technical portfolio and competitor solutions
* Very deep understanding of Network KPI’s for Active Antenna Systems (AAS), beam configurations and correlation to antenna system architecture
* Highest expert level of competence in antenna system architecture, holistically and as a sum of its sub\-functions.
* Knowledge of radiator solutions for full range of applications and goals.
* Competence in the design of the radiator’s radiating and feeding sections, as well as environment components: cavities, directors, decoupling structures
* Expertise in signal distribution architectures, technologies (transmission lines, materials) and component design (power dividers, couplers, phase shifters, impedance transformers, filters, to assure optimal joint performance with the antenna front side and ultimately to enable the achievement of high level KPIs.
* Competence in the selection of and design with materials and solutions: metals, PCBs, dielectrics.
* Perfect understanding of the mechanical aspects that enable feasible, effective component and system materialization to the highest industry standards: possibilities, performance and constraints of materials and processes.
* Antenna EM modeling \& simulation tools
* Comprehensive knowledge of EM modeling and simulation tool possibilities that allow optimal antenna development.
* Personal skills
* Top level qualities as a leader: commitment, reliability, vision, creativity, flexibility, resilience.
* Excellent communication and influence skills.
* Confident fact\-based decision\-making.
* Embraces accountability.
* Balances empathy and practical sense.
* Personifies integrity.


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
