**Role Title: AVP, Information Security Program Manager (L10\)**


**Company Overview:**

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.


* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles

**Organizational Overview:**

The Information Security organization partners across Technology and the business to protect Synchrony’s customers, data, and platforms. The India InfoSec program function drives security culture, awareness, and engagement across sites, aligning local initiatives with enterprise security priorities and ensuring strong participation, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution.


**Role Summary/Purpose:**

As AVP, Information Security Program Manager, you will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of India\-focused InfoSec engagement programs that strengthen security culture and community. This includes security hackathons/CTFs, university/student engagement, employee\-facing campaigns, and India hub/site\-level InfoSec initiatives. You will partner with Enterprise InfoSec leaders, India site leadership, universities, suppliers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-impact programs using Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.


**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Own the India InfoSec engagement roadmap and annual calendar; translate priorities into plans and measurable outcomes.
* Deliver year\-round security culture programs (communications, learning, contests, speaker sessions).
* Lead InfoSec hackathons/CTFs end\-to\-end: themes/objectives, problem statements (with SMEs/suppliers/universities), platform setup, participant onboarding, logistics, judging, recognition, and reporting/playbooks.
* Manage event budgets/forecasts, vendor coordination, and resource planning (as applicable).
* Ensure initiatives align with enterprise security policies, brand/communications standards, and legal/compliance requirements.
* Run a structured university engagement program (campus connects, guest lectures, workshops, mentorship, CTFs) and maintain key university partnerships.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition/HR and InfoSec leadership to translate hackathon outcomes into intern hiring recommendations and finalist tracking.
* Manage the InfoSec intern program: onboarding/orientation, check\-ins, milestone reviews, and mentor coordination.
* Define and track intern assignments/projects (goals, deliverables, timelines, success criteria) and maintain a centralized intern dashboard (joining/access/progress/ risks/outcomes).
* Coordinate internship closure (final demos, documentation handover, feedback/evaluations, and conversion recommendations where applicable) and drive continuous improvement of the pipeline.
* Drive Infosec India hub site initiatives (town halls, brown bags, community sessions, leadership visits).
* Coordinate across Enterprise InfoSec, Technology, Risk/Compliance, HR/L\&D, Communications, Legal, Procurement, Facilities, and business teams for scope, approvals, and delivery.
* Provide leadership dashboards, executive updates, and quarterly/annual impact summaries.
* Maintain program documentation in Confluence/SharePoint (charters, playbooks, comms plans, runbooks, asset libraries, retrospectives).
* Manage delivery in Jira (epics/stories, sprint planning, risk/issue/dependency tracking, status reporting).
* Ensure vendor governance (SOWs, deliverable quality, performance tracking, and required security controls).

**Required Skills/Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in program/project management, including hackathons/CTFs, university engagement, and employee\-facing events in an enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise InfoSec programs and cross\-functional initiatives end\-to\-end (planning, execution, governance, stakeholder management).
* Strong working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and hands\-on expertise with Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
* Proven ability to drive complex programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and time\-sensitive deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready reporting and broad employee communications.
* Strong execution discipline: risk/issue management, dependency tracking, vendor coordination, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Eligibility Criteria:** Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in program/project management, including hackathons/CTFs, university engagement, and employee\-facing events in an enterprise environment.


**Work Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM IST \- (This role requires the candidate to be based in Hyderabad location)**


This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may periodically due to business needs)

Vishram Management Group (VMG) is seeking a highly sophisticated, purely independent, and execution\-focused Senior HR Manager. This is not a traditional HR role; it is a full\-ownership mandate for an HR architect who can build, scale, and discipline a high\-performance organization from scratch.

Operating across multiple diverse business verticals—including Study Abroad, Work Abroad, (VIS) as well as Retail, QSR (Quick Service Restaurants), and Backend Operations (VMG)—you will design the infrastructure that governs our talent lifecycle. You will be fully empowered to operate autonomously, implementing systems, driving accountability, and optimizing human capital ROI without requiring day\-to\-day supervision.

Responsibilities

1\. Absolute HR Ownership \& Governance

* Take end\-to\-end strategic and operational accountability for the entire HR lifecycle across both entities (VIS \& VMG).

2\. Strategic Talent Acquisition \& Team Architecture

* Design, implement, and scale aggressive sourcing and hiring strategies tailored for both high\-volume roles (Sales, QSR, Retail) and highly specialized corporate roles.

* Implement productivity tracking systems, time\-tracking tools, and CRM alignments to monitor remote employee output seamlessly.

4\. High\-Performance Management \& Accountability

* Design and implement comprehensive Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for every tier of the organization.
* Establish a culture of strict meritocracy and accountability.
* Concurrently manage underperformance with professional objectivity—executing structured Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), delivering formal warnings, and confidently making timely termination decisions when necessary.

5\. SOP Development \& Process Standardization

* Draft, codify, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for every HR process.
* Build a comprehensive, digitized employee handbook and institutionalize onboarding pathways that ensure new hires are productive within their first week.

6\. Cost Optimization \& Compensation Architecture

* Continuously audit and optimize compensation structures, incentives, and benefit plans to maximize organizational ROI.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure maximum business output per employee, mitigating overhead leakages.

Candidate Requirements

* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3\+ years in a Talent Leadership, HR Manager, or Head of HR capacity.

Core Competencies \& Traits

* High Ownership Mindset: An entrepreneurial operator who looks at the business as their own and actively seeks solutions rather than pointing out problems.
* Execution\-Obsessed: Strong preference for action and measurable outcomes over theoretical strategies.
* Radical Candor: Comfortable navigating difficult conversations, managing conflict, and executing necessary exit strategies with absolute professionalism and legal compliance.
* Process\-Driven: Exceptional attention to detail with an inherent need to organize workflows, build checklists, and leave zero room for operational oversights.

Mandatory Tool Requirements (Non\-Negotiable)

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


Talent Acquisition Specialist is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**


As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.


Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.


The TA Specialist has the following responsibilities:


* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.

Additional roles and responsibilities include:


* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* .
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* . Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.

**Who is USP Looking For?**


The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 8 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)

**Additional Desired Preferences**


* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


None, this is an individual contributor role.


**Benefits**


USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.


Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

* **Implementing Corrective and Preventive Actions:**QC Engineers work with cross\-functional teams to implement corrective and preventive actions to address identified quality issues and prevent recurrence.

* **Collaborating with Teams:**QC Engineers collaborate with various departments, including production, engineering, and supply chain, to ensure that quality standards are met throughout the entire process.
* **Staying Updated:**They stay current with industry trends, new technologies, and regulatory requirements related to quality control to continuously improve processes and procedures.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
About ARCHLE Labs

ARCHLE Labs – Advanced Research Centre for Health and Life Science Engineering is a health\-tech R\&D startup based in Bangalore. We are building science and engineering\-driven healthcare solutions that improve access, affordability, and quality of care.

Our vision is simple:

To make quality healthcare accessible to everyone.

India needs healthcare solutions that are practical, scalable, and accessible across diverse communities. This requires professionals who can support systems, coordinate teams, manage operations, and help bring innovation to the people who need it most.

At ARCHLE Labs, your work will not be limited to routine office tasks. You will be part of a mission\-driven team working to build products, systems, and operations that support the future of public health.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Executive who will be responsible for selling hospital software solutions and medical devices to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and healthcare institutions.

The role involves identifying potential customers, visiting hospitals and clinics, understanding their requirements, presenting ARCHLE Labs’ healthcare solutions, conducting product demonstrations, following up with prospects, and closing sales.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with field sales, customer communication, product explanation, lead generation, and meeting healthcare decision\-makers such as doctors, clinic owners, hospital administrators, purchase managers, and biomedical teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate leads from hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and healthcare providers.
* Visit hospitals and clinics to present hospital software solutions and medical devices.
* Meet doctors, clinic owners, hospital administrators, biomedical engineers, purchase managers, and other key decision\-makers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable healthcare software or device solutions.
* Conduct product demos and explain features, benefits, pricing, and use cases clearly.
* Follow up with leads and convert prospects into customers.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, and healthcare professionals.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product demos, quotations, proposals, installation, training, and after\-sales support.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer visits, follow\-ups, sales pipeline, and closures.
* Track customer interactions using CRM tools, Excel, Google Sheets, or internal sales systems.
* Collect market feedback, competitor information, and customer requirements.
* Support payment follow\-ups and customer onboarding when required.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to sell to hospitals, clinics, doctors, and healthcare institutions.
* Good presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Confidence to conduct field visits and meet senior decision\-makers.
* Basic understanding of healthcare, hospital workflows, medical devices, or software products.
* Ability to explain technical products in a simple and convincing manner.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined, target\-oriented, and willing to travel.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, CRM tools, or sales tracking systems.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Science, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, healthcare sales, hospital software sales, medical device sales, pharma sales, or institutional sales preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to work in field sales may also apply.
* Prior experience selling to hospitals, clinics, doctors, or healthcare institutions will be an added advantage.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in HMIS sales or hospital management software sales.
* Experience selling healthcare software to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, or diagnostic centres.
* Understanding of hospital workflows such as registration, appointment management, billing, pharmacy, lab, EMR/EHR, patient records, and reporting.

description:
**Job Title :** Academic Counsellor / Overseas Education Counsellor

**Company :** Medcity International Overseas Corporation

**Industry :** Study Abroad

**Job Location :** Kannur

**Job Type :** Full Time, On\-site

**Benefits :** Attractive Incentives (Spot Incentives)

The Overseas Education Counsellor holds a significant responsibility towards the study abroad business as this role is entitled to provide accurate information about professional courses abroad, best destinations, admission options available in top\-ranking universities and colleges, nearest possible intakes, visa and documentation process and lot more. The counsellor’s timely guidance, counselling assistance and clear communication with the client matters a lot.

**Key areas of responsibility**

**Student Counselling**

Provide personalized counseling to students based on their academic background, career goals, budget, and preferred destinations.

Advise students on suitable study destinations, universities, and courses that align with their interests and qualifications.

Assist students with inquiries, providing in\-depth knowledge and suggestions based on their needs.

Engage with students in a positive, approachable, and respectful manner.

**Targets \& Registrations**

Achieve or exceed daily, weekly, monthly and yearly targets by using effective counselling techniques and strategies

Inform clients to attend attractive webinars, expos, events, and study abroad virtual sessions to enhance chances of registrations

Having the best knowledge of all study abroad destinations, programs, eligibility requirements, culture, rules and regulations of various countries, etc. can help in achieving goals easily.

**Calls \& Follow\-ups**

Achieving 50 connected calls on a daily basis can bring in better results in terms of your work productivity

Follow\-ups on a timely basis for all enquiries and for all registered clients can make the results better and relationships longer .

**Lead Generation**

As a counselor with experience and knowledge, contribute with your creativity, ideas and talents to attract and generate potential leads

Involve in activities such as content preparation for course promotions, webinars, script writing for videos and reels, planning and coordination for in\-house expos and events, initiate programs and presentations with schools / colleges

**Record Keeping \& Report**

Prepare daily, weekly, monthly reports and update the sheet every evening before 5 Pm.

Lead Sheet, Registration status, Client documents etc. need to be shared with the respective point of contacts within the TAT

Keep a record of information, client data, course details, fee structure, website information (bookmarks), etc for timely references

**Research \& Update Knowledge**

As a student counselor (Academic resource person), it is important to stay updated with the latest trends and challenges, intakes opened/closed, new services and offers,etc.

Learn about the study abroad industry, competitors, market, business updates and strategies that fit better towards your goals

**Participation \& Support**

Participate in all major events hosted or initiated by the respective branch. This can be related to a Webinar, In\-house Expo, Seminar, Delegate Meeting, Training Session, Discussions etc.

**Team / Branch Meetings**

Daily, Weekly, and Monthly meetings will be happening at regular intervals. Always be prepared to discuss the status of the work, plans, and initiatives. Morning and Evening briefing sessions with the respective BM will be held daily.

**Walk\-in’s / Virtual Counselling**

Counsellor must be able to generate 10\-20 successful walk\-in’s every month followed by virtual counselling for those clients who are far and unable to directly reach the office.

**Branch Visits / Lead Calls**

Counsellor should be able to visit the allocated branches (Academy) for receiving leads and to directly meet students. Lead follow\-ups and calls must be regularly done to build a strong relationship with the respective branches, CRO and students

**Qualifications / Requirements**

A bachelor’s degree in education, international relations, business, or a related field.

Experience in counseling or student services, especially in the context of international education.

preference for freshers with excellent Language proficiency

*Strong Communication Skills*

*Organizational Skills*

*Multitasking*
